items.title: ALBUMMER! 21: The Tournament of Champions
items.description: On this episode on Albummer!, we take a look back at the twenty albums we listened to last year and try to determine gauntlet-style which one gave us the most trauma. This is our Apocolypse Now. May God have mercy on our souls.

items.title: It’s all come to this... Which match-up gets an episode? Will the furry cartoon carnivores get Wile E. Coyote VS Tom Cat? Or will the furious godslayers get Kratos VS Asura? items.title: Jeopardy! Tournament of Champions QF #4: September 23, 2004
items.description: The fourth quarterfinal game of Jeopardy's 2004 Tournament of Champions features five-day champion Chris Miller, three-day champion Tom Baker, & four-day champion Russ Schumacher.

items.title: Jeopardy James Holzhauer Dethroned
items.description:
Family and friends gathered in anticipation of seeing James Holzhauer break a record, but were shocked when the champ was beaten.
